marunouchi
workData.subTitle: Designed a premium website and intuitive app for a next-gen co-working space, driving 2x member growth, 3.8x individual sign-ups, and Japan’s first WELL Certification.

content.text: point 0 marunouchi is a co-working space launched in July 2019, redefining the “future of office spaces” by integrating advanced technologies and supporting diverse working styles.

As the Product Designer for point 0 marunouchi, I designed the website and app to reflect the space’s high-end, futuristic concept while providing a seamless user experience. The app included features such as reservations, payments, announcements, and location services, catering to the needs of busy professionals.

point 0 marunouchi offers a unique co-working experience with open spaces, meeting rooms, and nap booths equipped with cutting-edge solutions. Leveraging advanced data collection and biometrics, the space continuously improves its offerings through analysis and experimentation.

In January 2021, it became the first co-working office in Japan to earn WELL Certification (WELL v2 pilot) at the Gold level. This achievement was made possible through partnerships with Okamura Corporation, Daikin Industries, and Panasonic, incorporating expertise in air quality, furniture, and lighting.

As a testbed for WORKTECH innovations, point 0 marunouchi hosts unique experiments and initiatives led by 17 participating companies, including Daikin, Okamura, Panasonic, TOTO, Asahi, Epson, Microsoft, and Sony. Starting with 10 committee members at launch, this network quickly expanded within a year.
A user-friendly website and app design would align with the space’s premium and innovative concept.
Intuitive app features, such as reservations and location services, would enhance user engagement and satisfaction.
Highlighting advanced technologies and high-end solutions would position point 0 marunouchi as a leading workspace for professionals.
Designed a premium website with calming colors and sophisticated layouts, targeting business professionals while emphasizing innovation.
Developed an intuitive app with key features, including reservations, payments, announcements, and location services.
Simplified navigation with minimalistic layouts to streamline interactions and improve usability.
Ensured the app’s design aligned with the branding of point 0 marunouchi, reinforcing its high-end identity.
Increased user engagement through intuitive app features for bookings, payments, and community interactions.
Positioned point 0 marunouchi as a leading co-working space recognized for its advanced technology and user-centered design.
Achieved Japan’s first WELL Certification (WELL v2 pilot) for a co-working office.
Registered members grew from 809 to 1696, corporate contracts doubled from 16 to 30, and individual memberships increased 3.8x from 80 to 303.
Clear and intuitive design plays a crucial role in improving satisfaction for multifunctional apps.
Showcasing innovative technologies enhances brand perception and appeal to professionals.
Consistency across digital platforms and physical spaces builds trust and strengthens brand identity.

This project positioned point 0 marunouchi as an innovative, luxurious workspace that sets a new standard for future office spaces by combining advanced technology, thoughtful design, and seamless user experiences.

next.title:
Pocket Change
Poke Pay
next.subTitle: Delivered seamless currency exchange experiences through branding, web, and kiosk UX/UI, driving a 140% sales increase.

content.text: “Pocket Change” is an innovative technology company revolutionizing foreign currency exchange with kiosks installed across Japan. These kiosks allow users to exchange foreign currency, recharge transportation IC cards, and convert leftover balances into points or e-money for other services.

As the Lead Product Designer, I developed the company’s branding, corporate identity, design system, and website. I also designed intuitive, multilingual interfaces for the kiosks to ensure accessibility for a diverse, international user base.

Pocket Change aimed to simplify foreign currency exchange by providing a seamless solution for travelers, while expanding its range of services with e-money and voucher partnerships worldwide. By focusing on user accessibility and convenience, the company sought to position itself as the go-to currency exchange service in Japan.
: Accepts 10 different currencies, with plans for further expansion.
: Offers a wide variety of global options, including PayPal, WeChat, Rakuten, and Amazon Gift Certificates, along with public transportation e-money like Rakuten Edy, WAON, and nanaco.
: Allows users to donate leftover currency to organizations like UNICEF.
: 80 kiosks installed nationwide, including major airports in Japan.
A visually appealing, intuitive kiosk interface and website will improve user engagement and satisfaction.
Expanding currency and e-money options will attract more users and increase transaction volume.
Promoting the service’s wide coverage and diverse offerings will enhance brand awareness and trust.
Established a cohesive brand image, creating high-quality photographs of kiosks, employees, and locations.
Designed a comprehensive design system to ensure consistency across digital and physical touchpoints.
Built a responsive corporate website from scratch, aligning it with the company’s mission and showcasing its features, coverage, and partnerships.
Developed an intuitive, multilingual kiosk interface to cater to international users, focusing on graphical designs to transcend language barriers.
Highlighted the seamless process for exchanging currency, recharging IC cards, and converting balances into vouchers or donations.
Incorporated messaging about expanding currency offerings and new partnerships to build user trust and confidence.
Enhanced the service’s usability by adding features like detailed instructions and an instructional video to the website.
: “Pocket Change” won the Good Design Award in 2018 for its innovative service and user-friendly design.
: 80+ kiosks installed nationwide, including major airports, serving millions of users annually.
: Partnered with international services like PayPal and WeChat, as well as Japan-specific e-money providers like Rakuten Edy and WAON.
: Multilingual and visually intuitive designs improved accessibility and satisfaction for international travelers.
: Designing for continuous service and currency expansion is essential for long-term growth.
: Multilingual support and partnerships with local services like Japanese e-money providers increase user trust and engagement.
: Combining digital platforms (website) and physical kiosks in a seamless ecosystem maximizes user adoption.

This project successfully positioned “Pocket Change” as a trusted, innovative solution for currency exchange, leveraging thoughtful design and strategic partnerships to serve both international travelers and domestic users, while addressing financial challenges for sustainable growth.
